## [1.10.2](https://github.com/Pirrotto/aare-patches/compare/v1.10.1...v1.10.2) (2026-11-22)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Speak and play voice messages on the car's guidance channel ([1ae0b09](https://github.com/Pirrotto/aare-patches/commit/1ae0b09d29755f41a626b0e357ac23f5b7325cf5))
* Tunnel navigation follows curves and stays on the road ([55ae193](https://github.com/Pirrotto/aare-patches/commit/55ae193e069b14ca7eb421012eced4fbd0e81ad0))

patches.name: AARE assistant
patches.description: The voice button opens AARE's own assistant on the car screen, in Italian, German or English: navigation, music, messages and replies, calls, the time. For anything else it opens the phone's assistant (Google).

patches.name: Background location
patches.description: Declares the background location permission, so that after choosing "Allow all the time" for AARE in the system settings, navigation apps keep GPS with the phone locked even when AARE starts the car connection in the background.

patches.name: Car microphone
patches.description: Dictated replies and AARE's assistant listen through the car's microphone (the phone's if the car has none). Android 13 or newer.

patches.name: Integrated Shizuku
patches.description: AARE starts its own Shizuku through wireless debugging, without the Shizuku app: pair once from Settings, and AARE starts it again by itself after a restart and when the car connects, on any Wi-Fi including the car's.

patches.name: Settings
patches.description: Adds "Settings" to AARE's settings home: one switch with a short description for each installed patch. New releases of the patches add their switches there by themselves.

patches.name: Tunnel navigation
patches.description: With the car's GPS used for the phone, the position keeps moving in tunnels: it is estimated from the car's speed, compass and gyroscope until the GPS is back.

patches.name: Voice messages
patches.description: Plays WhatsApp voice messages in the car when a message is read aloud, instead of reading "Voice message (0:05)". Reads them through Shizuku, which AARE already uses for car audio, so AARE needs no storage permission.

patches.name: Voice reply
patches.description: After a message is read aloud, shows a "Reply" card on the car screen for 15 seconds, and adds "Reply" to the messages of the notification centre. Replying lets you dictate the answer, shown live on the car screen, then send it after saying "yes" or tapping "Send". Uses the phone's speech recognition, on the phone when available.
